text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder

My apologies, but may I step outside<n>for some air?
I need to feel the<n>breeze.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It's all right, Trainer. I don't want to<n>inconvenience
you.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Why is that? This loss was my fault<n>and mine
alone.
choice_data_list:
It's a long journey to the top. Everyone needs a
leg up now and then.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Point taken. I'll keep climbing, so<n>would you lend
me your strength,<n>Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder's hair ripples in the<n>breeze as we
discuss what led to<n>today's defeat.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...I would prefer to be somewhere<n>else if possible. I
know it's a selfish<n>request.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
After all the times I've returned to<n>this room
following a loss... just the<n>sight of it fills me with
frustration.
choice_data_list: That's exactly why we should stay.
That's exactly why we should stay.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
choice_data_list: You have to confront that feeling.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...I see. Not doing so would be running<n>away.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Very well. I will face this frustration<n>now so that I
may prevent it from<n>befalling me again.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Afterwards, Grass Wonder and I<n>evaluate
everything that went wrong<n>in today's race.
